facts.fact: Of Raghu's eight bound pairs, seven are in the Hollow Moon bowl and the eighth pair has sat on the Kuhl shoulder over the head of the Glass Lakes for two nights; Dhanu's boy saw their fire from the upper fold (ties the ch12 shoulder fire, F695, to Raghu).
Raghu's men came to the Hollow Moon by the Kuhl cut (matches F535); only Hari's nine goats were driven up the Hollow Moon road.
Dhanu's boy ran in from the upper folds two nights ago.

The Drum fold is hidden from the Kuhl shoulder by the cliff overhang, per Ila's sight from the mouth of the Eye; the 300 paces of open shore to reach it are exposed. Ila puts the risk at one in ten (one watcher asleep, the other dazzled by his fire, no lamp), residual risk named.
Ila and Kunal have shared quarters nine times; Ila carries the queen's letter against her ribs; Kunal said 'and I came home' in a snow cave on the Hollow Moon.
Ila and Kunal stood on the Eye's ice in full sun that morning and may have been seen from the shoulder.
